verdict.rationale: The only memory specs in the pack come from a community review: 16 GB of GDDR7 on a 256-bit bus at 896 GB/s. No evidence shows a 70B-class quantized model fitting in or running on this card. NVIDIA's generic claims about running 'the latest AI models locally' do not mention model size or 70B-class inference, so the story's core capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a 70B-class quantized LLM on this GPU — published VRAM capacity and memory bandwidth that make local or single-node inference practical
